name: tic-vla-orin-upstream-reproduction
title: Run released TIC-VLA checkpoint on Jetson Orin
description: Pin TIC-VLA and run its released pretrained checkpoint directly on the Jetson AGX Orin 64GB in a bounded receive-only compatibility smoke, without training or robot actuation.
creator: sun
notes: Completed the bounded offline Orin CUDA compatibility test with one warm-up and three serial measured forwards. The checkpoint hash matched, strict state-dict compatibility passed with no missing, unexpected, or shape-mismatched keys, and all measured outputs had finite shape (1, 30, 2). The preflight stop and Dr Sun's subsequent authorization for coexistence with the untouched Lite3 DDS/root-session infrastructure remain recorded in STOP_REPORT.md. No training, robot command, listener, persistent service, protected system modification, staging, or Git commit was performed.
